# gpg Provider

Manage the [vault-plugin-secrets-gpg](https://github.com/IUCLabs/vault-plugin-secrets-gpg) secrets engine (mounts and OpenPGP keys) on HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao.

Resources and data sources use the `gpg_` prefix, so declare the provider under the local name `gpg` in `required_providers`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    gpg = {
      source = "IUCLabs/vault-secrets-gpg"
    }
  }
}

# address and token fall back to VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN.
provider "gpg" {
  address = "https://vault.example.com:8200"
}

resource "gpg_secret_backend" "gpg" {
  path = "gpg"
}

resource "gpg_key" "app" {
  backend  = gpg_secret_backend.gpg.path
  name     = "app"
  identity = "App <app@example.com>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Address of the Vault/OpenBao server. Falls back to the VAULT_ADDR environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token used to authenticate to Vault/OpenBao. Falls back to the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable.
